name: Dolly Night
source:
Shibuya. Boy Junna wakes up in the alley dump with a memory loss. Girl Hina floats before him asking to look for something and disappears. A silver-hair man in the black veil Arstad passes by revoking nostalgia feelings. 
Detective Tagami chases puppet master Arstad suspected of murder. 
What's the truth behind the murders, the memory loss and the object searched by Hina?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
涩谷。少年纯名在小巷垃圾堆中醒来，已经失去记忆。女孩Hina漂浮在他面前，请他寻找某件东西后消失。随后，一个罩着黑色面纱的银发男子Arstad从旁走过，唤起纯名心中的怀念之情。
刑警田上正在追捕涉嫌谋杀的傀儡师Arstad。
连环谋杀、记忆丧失，以及Hina寻找之物的背后究竟隐藏着怎样的真相？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
